observation_interpretation.cold: Absolute Source-entry monotonic nanoseconds; RETURNED, IN_PROGRESS and OPEN_AT_FAILURE are different. Missing/unstarted rows remain absent and None timestamps are not durations.
observation_interpretation.counter_scope: overall_tick_invocations/source_guard_invocations/completed/failed/timed_intervals/elapsed_ns are cold-local aggregate counters only. Do not infer Arena/adapter callback dispatch counts, public/completion checkpoints, mathematical operation counts or disjoint guard costs.
observation_interpretation.cutoff: cold_observation.snapshot_cutoff_ns limits counts and rows to that detached snapshot. Later final guards, fixed-point ledger/receipt serialization, cleanup and worker exit are outside it. It is not a full-window invocation count.
observation_interpretation.driver: Absolute caller monotonic seconds; action_returned and completed distinguish action result from successful post-action diagnostic. Failure-observed time can be unavailable; unavailable marker is not a complete normal packet.
observation_interpretation.old_decode_seconds: Inherited result_reading.decode_seconds starts before complete forest verification and therefore includes the inverse interval. Label as the inherited combined interval, not pure JSON decoding. New named subphases refine that view without changing old field semantics.
observation_interpretation.overlap: driver_run encloses driver finalization, saved_forest_full_comparison encloses independent_prepare and independent_stream_and_compare, and source_guard intervals can lie inside those stages. Never add enclosing and enclosed intervals as disjoint costs.
observation_interpretation.store_statistics: Only passive existing Store.statistics snapshots; no guard, stream, inverse or scientific replay. Counters are observations, not independent resource/Native authority.
observation_interpretation.units: Keep float driver seconds and cold integer nanoseconds labeled; any conversion for display is presentation arithmetic with ordinary precision limitations, not a new exact custody predicate.

retained_failure_policy.cold: Keep existing bounded worker-failure schema with owned_finalization_observation, owned_evidence_statistics, driver_returned_receipt, cold_observation, diagnostic_output_prefixes, stage_intervals and Native cleanup metadata. Preserve each actual available item; missing is unavailable, not reconstructed after the window.
retained_failure_policy.downstream: If outer rejects before reading a normal worker header, preserve any raw failure file/logs by descriptor as diagnostic custody without importing components or retrospectively probing/filling missing telemetry. Runner/observer failure booleans and nulls remain literal.
retained_failure_policy.driver: On action/clock/metadata failure, same error carries best-effort owned_finalization_observation; unavailable marker explicitly has complete_ledger_retained false and no authority.
retained_failure_policy.no_masking: Best-effort observation timestamps/copy/serialization cannot replace the active exception. No partial normal header, no late rewritten result or evidence forest, no cap increase.
retained_failure_policy.no_rescue: Any late inverse/Reader/point/source/deadline/output/resource failure preserves the exact original error and unsuccessful status; an earlier Native candidate or complete driver packet does not admit a proof or retry.
